tasks.verified: A 51-case date/time verbiage matrix measured against the live gateway - every natural phrasing class a patient uses (absolute, weekday, relative, anaphora, clock, day-part, window, edge, negation) answered HTTP 200 with its resolution recorded, so remaining interpretation gaps are enumerated from evidence instead of discovered by patients.
tasks.spec: python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env GW_TOKEN=conductor/agents/bland-mott/api-key -- python3 -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/checks/gw_datetime_coverage.py > coverage.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat coverage.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -qE 'DT_DONE total=[0-9]+ http_ok=[0-9]+' coverage.txt || { echo 'FAIL: sweep did not complete'; tail -4 coverage.txt; exit 1; }; t=$(grep -oE 'DT_DONE total=[0-9]+' coverage.txt | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); ok=$(grep -oE 'http_ok=[0-9]+' coverage.txt | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); [ "$t" = "$ok" ] || { echo "FAIL: $((t-ok)) cases errored"; grep 'err=[^ ]' coverage.txt | head -5; exit 1; }; n=$(grep -cE '^DT=' coverage.txt); [ "$n" -ge 50 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n case lines"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $n-case coverage matrix captured, all HTTP 200"
